newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Human Genome started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Human Genome started.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said on Monday analyst Douglas Melancon started coverage of biotechnology company Human Genome Sciences Inc with a rating of near- and long-term accumulate.
-- "We see Human Genome as a long-term holding because they won't see any earnings until the end of the decade," Melancon said in a Reuter interview.
-- However, "we'll probably see filings with the FDA (Food and Drug Administration) toward the end of 1997 to begin clinical trials (of drugs) in 1998."
-- Shares in the Rockville, Md., company opened up 3/4 at 35-3/4.
